reason: HGB_RAW_PARITY applies the outer-training 60% feature screen once, then 3-split chronological calibration subfits. In 14/40 HGB jobs, the first inner training slice contains eligible columns with zero/one finite observations; sklearn 1.9.0 HistGradientBoosting binning raises ValueError: window shape cannot be larger than input array shape. This is an execution/preprocessing defect, not a preregistered scientific failure condition.
repair: Create V1.4.1 before scoring. Preserve all six methods and frozen data. Repair HGB only by fitting an identical training-slice-local median imputer with keep_empty_features=True before each inner HGB calibration subfit and before the final outer-training HGB fit, applied identically to M0 and M1. No method/threshold/fold/target/evaluation change.
